description: Read the quote posts behind a Bluesky post's "quoteCount" — the posts that embed it with commentary of their own, newest first. On Bluesky this is where much of the reaction to a post lives; bsky_get_post_thread returns replies only. Accepts the post's AT-URI (at://<handle-or-did>/app.bsky.feed.post/<rkey>) from the "uri" field of any returned post, or its bsky.app URL (https://bsky.app/profile/<handle-or-did>/post/<rkey>); a handle costs one extra lookup. Returns each quote post with full text, author, engagement counts, and AT-URI. Each result's embed names the queried post by AT-URI and CID only — its text is not repeated on every result — and keeps any media the quoting post attached. "quoteCount" is an upper bound on what this returns: Bluesky's counter keeps quotes that have left the index. Supports cursor pagination.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response for the same post, passed back unchanged. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: Maximum number of quote posts to return (1–100). Default 25. Pages often hold fewer than the limit and still continue — follow the cursor, not the count. A page that would pass the 48,000-byte response budget comes back with fewer quotes and "budgetCapped: true"; its cursor continues from the first quote it left out.

uri.description: The post whose quotes to read — its AT-URI, e.g. "at://did:plc:z72i7hdynmk6r22z27h6tvur/app.bsky.feed.post/3l6oveex3ii2l", or its bsky.app URL, e.g. "https://bsky.app/profile/bsky.app/post/3l6oveex3ii2l"; a trailing "/", "?…", or "#…" on the URL is ignored. Posts only — a feed, profile, or list address is rejected.

name: bsky_get_post_quotes

budgetCapped.description: True when a page of the requested limit would have passed this server's 48,000-byte response budget, so Bluesky was asked again for fewer quotes and that page was returned whole. The cursor comes from that same response, so paging on from it skips nothing. Independent of "truncated", which still means only that a cursor was returned.

cap.description: The limit applied to this page.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Absent when there are no more quotes.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `post_not_found`: No post exists at that address, or the handle in it does not resolve to an account. `invalid_cursor`: Bluesky could not continue from the cursor the request carried — it answers a cursor it cannot decode with HTTP 500. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance on the page: that more quotes can be fetched with the returned cursor, or why the page is empty — the post has no readable quotes, or the last page was reached.

posts.description: Posts quoting the queried post, newest first.

items.description: A post quoting the queried post.

avatar.description: URL of the author avatar image.

did.description: Permanent DID of the author, e.g. "did:plc:z72i7hdynmk6r22z27h6tvur".

displayName.description: Display name set by the author.

handle.description: Human-readable handle of the author, e.g. "alice.bsky.social".

verification.description: Bluesky verification of the author — what tells a verified account from a look-alike handle. Absent when Bluesky sent none. Who issued it is on bsky_get_profile.

trustedVerifierStatus.description: Whether the author is itself a trusted verifier — same values as verifiedStatus.

verifiedStatus.description: Whether a trusted verifier verified the author: "valid", "invalid" (verified once, no longer holds), or "none". Passed through as Bluesky sends it, so another value may appear.

cid.description: Content Identifier (CID) of the quote post record.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this post was created.

embed.description: The embed on this quote post. On every result it is a "record" embed pointing at the queried post, cut back to what the quoting post itself carries: { uri, cid, recordKind?, media? } — uri and cid address the queried post (the revision this quote points at), recordKind is set only when that post is unreadable ("notFound" | "blocked" | "detached"), and media is the image/video/link the quoting post attached alongside the quote. The queried post's own text, author, and attachments are not restated on each result. Other shapes, should an embed point elsewhere: images: { images: [{ url, alt }] }; external: { uri, title, description }; record: { uri, cid, text?, authorHandle?, embeds?, media?, omittedEmbeds?, recordKind? }; video: { playlist?, thumbnail?, presentation? }; unknown: { raw }.

indexedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this post was indexed.

items.description: A moderation label applied by the AppView or a labeler service.

cts.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the label was applied.

src.description: DID of the labeler that applied this label. Equal to the post author DID when the account labelled its own post, and a labeler service DID otherwise.

val.description: Label value (content warning or moderation tag, e.g. "porn", "spam").

quoteCount.description: Number of quote posts Bluesky counts for this quote post — read them with this tool. An upper bound on what it returns, since the counter keeps quotes that have left the index.

replyCount.description: Number of replies to this quote post.

replyRootUri.description: AT-URI of the post the conversation it replies in started from, if it is also a reply.

replyToUri.description: AT-URI of the post this quote post replies to, if it is also a reply.

text.description: Full text of the quote post — the commentary on the queried post.

uri.description: AT-URI of the quote post, e.g. "at://did:plc:xxx/app.bsky.feed.post/yyy". Pass to bsky_get_post_thread for the replies to it, or back to this tool for its own quotes.

shown.description: Number of quote posts returned on this page.

totalReturned.description: Number of quote posts in this response page.

truncated.description: True when Bluesky returned a cursor, whatever this page held — pages often come back short of the limit with more behind them.

uri.description: AT-URI of the post whose quotes these are, in DID form — the form Bluesky was asked in, whatever form the input took.

title: Get Bluesky Post Quotes
